title: spec(data): search-fields.ts still calls a declared json search column "a scan that CAN match"; since #29394 the expansion skips it
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQxwoGb5fSnrFkpxmt

立卡门: ① 已落地工作欠的后续。PR #29502(#29394)合约复审 6583544380 should-fix 2 点名;落点具名，一处注释加一处测试注释。
业务理由: `search-fields.ts` 的 declared-branch 文字是搜索契约的唯一书面依据，作者和 AI 按它判断在 `searchableFields` 里放什么字段。#29502 让 `$search` 展开时跳过永不支持字符串的列(number / boolean / 日期 / json 等，判定读 spec 的 `textOperatorDoorVerdict`)。可这段文字仍说声明的 json 列是「a scan that CAN match」。不修的话，读者会以为把 json 字段放进搜索集能搜到东西。
动手的读者: domain:spec 席。改 `packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts` 约 L288 的 declared-branch 注释，以及 `search-fields.test.ts` 约 L314 的同句测试注释，写明：从未支持字符串的类型仍可声明，但搜索展开不给它们出子句，搜到 0 行。
查重: `searchable json scan CAN match` 43 命中，前列为 #29394 本身与 QA 跑批卡，没有改这段文字的卡。

Follow-up of: #29394 (PR #29502)

## Wanted
- The declared-branch text says: a declared column of a never-string-capable type (per `textOperatorDoorVerdict` in `packages/spec/src/data/filter-text-operator-declared-type.ts`) is admitted to the set but contributes no clause. A set made only of such columns answers no rows. Only "there is no column at all" is refused, as now.
- Comment-only. ⛔ No behaviour change (the skip lives in `packages/objectql/src/search-filter.ts`). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. No changeset unless the gate asks.
